newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Chrysler EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Chrysler EPS.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers auto analyst Jack Kirnan said Thursday he is increasing his estimate for Chrysler Corp's 1997 full year earnings by $0.10 a share to $4.90 in light of the automaker's first quarter earnings performance.
But he said he will continue to rate the shares a hold.

In a research report, Kirnan said $0.05 of the increase is due to Chrysler's $1.45 a share first quarter earnings outperforming his own estimate and $0.05 is due to an improved outlook for the automaker's second quarter earnings because of recently increased production schedules, which are now seven percent above last year's second quarter.

-- Kirnan said, however, that Chrysler's second half earnings per share comparisons "will be constrained" by expected heavy launch costs associated with the all-new 1998 LH large cars and the Dodge Durango sport utility vehicle, coupled with record results in the third and fourth quarters of 1996.

-- "Given that backdrop and the likelihood of what could be further tightening moves by the Federal Reserve, we envision the shares remaining in a fairly narrow trading band," Kirnan wrote. "As such, we continue to rate the shares a hold."
Chrysler shares closed off 1/8 at 29-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange Thursday.
